body:
## Council question

Provide or verify the full card-name and copy-count list, including the six worthless cards, weapons, defenses and special cards. Keep the four Supplies cache cards and Fate Indicators separate from the Treachery draw deck.

## Source evidence

Quickstart v0.8 lists removals and additions relative to GF9, including two Mercenaries. The recovered JSX lists a 45-card deck. The linked production deck currently contains only Supplies, Shield and Snooper and is incomplete, so it cannot establish intended copy counts.

## Draft treatment

The supported surrounding rules are drafted. This detail is marked as awaiting council verification; no answer has been assumed.

## Sources

Quickstart v0.8, Treachery Deck; recovered Cards.tsx; production Dreamrules Treachery Deck and Supplies cache.

Part of #1831. Norbert will review these questions together after the full drafting pass. An answer of "I think so, but I need to verify" remains provisional.

comments.body:
The deck has now been reconstructed in the database under Central, using the original Dreamrules JSX book's explicit 45-card inventory and the recovered card stories. The v0.8 guide supplies the later card-rule changes. This is the working inventory for the rulebook; the cards are no longer blocked on recovering their definitions.

[Dreamrules Treachery Deck](https://dune.zone/assets/deck/dreamrules-treachery-deck)

| Cards | Copies |
| --- | ---: |
| Baliset, Jubba Cloak, Kull Wahad, Kulon, La La La, Trip to Gamont | 1 each |
| Gom Jabbar, Chaumas, Chaumurky, Basilia Weapon, Ellaca Drug | 1 each |
| Stunner, Slip Tip, Maula Pistol, Crysknife, Hunter Seeker | 1 each |
| Snooper | 5 |
| Shield | 5 |
| Lasgun, Weirding Way, Chemistry | 1 each |
| Cheap Hero | 2 |
| Cheap Heroine | 1 |
| Karama, Truth Trance, Mercenaries | 2 each |
| Hajr, Weather Control, Tleilaxu Ghola, Family Atomics, Orange Catholic Bible, Break Conditioning, Supplies | 1 each |
| **Total** | **45** |

The four Supplies cache cards remain in their separate cache. Fate Indicators are also outside this draw deck.

The source stories had copied names on the Hajr and Stunner definitions; the recovered artwork and export names identify them correctly. Trip to Gamont uses the corrected place name. Cheap Heroine distinguishes the female artwork in the database and has the same rules as Cheap Hero.

Source evidence: `src/book/dreamrules/Cards.tsx` lists the counts; the card definitions were recovered from `src/game/assets/treachery/*.stories.ts` before commit `2c7307233fcb599dff209a98b0478a1bfb6fbe11` removed the static catalogues. Those stories have not been restored to Storybook. The database owns the reconstructed cards and deck membership.

This issue remains available for council confirmation or corrections to the current inventory. Recovery of the historical deck is complete; it is not evidence that every historical copy count has been ratified anew.
